createDebugJobModal.description.generate: Generate a debug bundle on this peer with logs and diagnostics. Useful for troubleshooting without CLI access.
createDebugJobModal.text.setsTheLimitFor: Sets the limit for how many individual log files will be included in the debug bundle.
createDebugJobModal.helpText.whenEnabled: When enabled, allows you to specify a time period for log collection before generating the debug bundle.
createDebugJobModal.text.timePeriodForWh: Time period for which logs should be collected before creating the debug bundle.
createDebugJobModal.helpText.removeSensi: Remove sensitive information (IP addresses, domains etc.) before creating the debug bundle.
createDebugJobModal.text.defaultKeepsInt: Default keeps internal (private) IP ranges readable; Strict also anonymizes private, CGNAT and link-local addresses.
createDebugJobModal.text.serviceThePeerR: Service the peer requests an upload URL from. Leave empty to use the default upload server. Must be an https URL.
